m.text: a platinum-plated dragon scale, worth at least 500 gp

entries: You create a field of silvery light that surrounds a creature of your choice within range (you can choose yourself). The field sheds dim light out to 5 feet. While surrounded by the field, a creature gains the following benefits:
The creature has resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, and poison damage.
items.name: Damage Resistance

entries: If the creature is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the creature instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.
items.name: Evasion

entries: As a bonus action on subsequent turns, you can move the field to another creature within 60 feet of the field.
name: Fizban's Platinum Shield
